powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules and regulations necessary to implement the NY ABLE act.
powers.quote: The comptroller is hereby authorized to promulgate any and all Rules and regulations necessary for the implementation of this article
powers.law_title: Establishes the New York achieving a better life experience (NY ABLE) savings account act

powers.action_summary: Implement the NY ABLE program through third party vendors as account administrators and financial organizations as depositories and managers.
powers.quote: The comptroller may implement the ny able savings account program through use of third party vendors as administrators of such accounts, and financial organizations as account depositories and managers.
powers.law_title: Establishes the New York achieving a better life experience (NY ABLE) savings account act

powers.action_summary: Solicit proposals from financial organizations to act as program depositories and managers.
powers.quote: The comptroller may solicit proposals from financial organizations to act as depositories and managers from the program.
powers.law_title: Establishes the New York achieving a better life experience (NY ABLE) savings account act

powers.action_summary: Enter into a contract with a financial organization to manage the program.
powers.quote: The comptroller may enter into a contract with a financial organization.
powers.law_title: Establishes the New York achieving a better life experience (NY ABLE) savings account act

powers.action_summary: Select more than one financial organization for the program.
powers.quote: The comptroller may select more than one financial organization for the program.
powers.law_title: Establishes the New York achieving a better life experience (NY ABLE) savings account act

powers.action_summary: Order an audit of a program depository and manager when concerned about its finances, recordkeeping or account status.
powers.quote: The comptroller may provide that an audit shall be conducted of the operations and financial position of the program depository and manager at any time if the comptroller has any reason to be concerned
powers.law_title: Establishes the New York achieving a better life experience (NY ABLE) savings account act

powers.action_summary: Enter into contracts necessary and proper for implementing the program.
powers.quote: The comptroller may enter into such contracts as it deems necessary and proper for the implementation of the program.
powers.law_title: Establishes the New York achieving a better life experience (NY ABLE) savings account act

powers.action_summary: Establish a nominal fee for NY ABLE account applications.
powers.quote: The comptroller may establish a nominal fee for such application.
powers.law_title: Establishes the New York achieving a better life experience (NY ABLE) savings account act

powers.action_summary: Enter into contracts for investment advice and management, custodial services and other professional services for the program.
powers.quote: The comptroller may enter into contracts to provide for investment advice and management, custodial services, and other professional services for the administration and investment of the program.
powers.law_title: Establishes the New York achieving a better life experience (NY ABLE) savings account act

powers.action_summary: Enter into contracts for administrative services and reporting for the trust fund.
powers.quote: The comptroller may enter into contracts to provide administrative services and reporting.
